name: Scotts Bluff National Monument
story: Scotts Bluff National Monument is located in western Nebraska, United States. It protects over 3,000 acres of towering bluffs, mixed-grass prairie, rugged badlands, and a riparian area along the North Platte River. The site was designated as a National Monument on December 12, 1919.
matters: The monument preserves historic overland trail remnants that served as an important landmark on the Oregon Trail, California Trail, Pony Express Trail, and Mormon Trail.
